zh-CN.name: 新拟态
zh-CN.description: 让组件与背景接近同一色系，通过相对的明暗阴影形成凸起或凹入的浮雕感。低对比边界容易使组件难以辨认，因此状态与可操作性需要额外提示。
use_when: 需要少量安静的浮雕式视觉强调。
有空间增加清楚的标签、边界与状态提示。
avoid_when: 密集表单与重要操作不应依赖低对比浮雕。
不要把装饰凸起自动等同于可点击。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
仅在少量表面使用同色系浮雕和相对的明暗阴影；按钮、输入框和选中状态补充清楚边界与标签；验证多种背景和显示条件，焦点与错误提示不依赖阴影。
专属演示：同色表面凸起与凹入对比，切换真实 aria-pressed 控件的内外阴影。 参数：投影偏移/扩散 {shadow_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Neumorphism
en.description: A style that uses closely matched component and background colors with paired light and dark shadows to suggest raised or inset relief. Low-contrast boundaries can make controls hard to identify, so states and interactivity need additional cues.
use_when: Selective quiet relief supports the visual direction.
Clear labels, boundaries and states can accompany the treatment.
avoid_when: Dense forms and critical actions should not depend on low-contrast relief.
Do not equate decorative elevation with clickability.
en.prompt_template:
Use closely matched surfaces and opposing light-dark shadows selectively. Give buttons, fields and selected states clear boundaries and labels. Check varied backgrounds and viewing conditions; focus and error cues must not depend on shadows.
Dedicated demonstration: Raised and inset same-color surfaces; a real aria-pressed control switches inner and outer shadows. Parameters: shadow offset/spread {shadow_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.
